tender.title: NESO Interim Capability
tender.description: National Energy System Operation (NESO) intends to award an Interim Capability agreement to Palantir Technologies UK Limited (Palantir) for continued licencing and support for Connections and Skip Rate related activities
tender.procurementMethodRationale:
It is considered that the contract can be awarded directly in accordance Section 41 of the Procurement Act 2023 paragraph 6 (absence of competition for technical reasons) of Schedule 5.
NESO currently runs two critical business processes - Connections and Skip Rates using the Palantir Foundry platform which is underpinned by proprietary architecture licensed exclusively by Palantir, Palantir possesses the specialist knowledge, technical expertise and the system knowledge required to maintain and support the solution effectively.  Transitioning to an alternative supplier is not possible without significant cost, resource commitment and delivery risk to meet regulatory obligations.  It would require the replacement of or significant redevelopment of the current data analytics environment, including migration of data, security accreditation of the replacement solution to the required standards, and training of NESO personnel. 
A contract will be put in place to enable continuity of the existing critical platform services whilst a competitive procurement is undertaken. A Pre Market Engagement notice for the strategic modelling capability has been published.
Disruption to the platform or associated services would impact the operational continuity of NESO's customer facing services and NESO's ability to fulfil regulatory requirements
tender.riskDetails: The future procurement requires the implementation of a new enterprise technology solution to support and enable modelling, analytical transparency, decision support and AI-enabled innovation. This will include the migration of NESOs information to the new supplier platform. Due to the complexity of legacy data structures and potential security, data quality, or regulatory compliance issues, the data modelling process may encounter unforeseen challenges. Should these risks materialise and impact data integrity, security, regulatory compliance and/or the successful transition of services, the contract may be modified including to extend the transition timeline
